title: Workspace UI to replace an active turn grant
description:
**Phase 1.** Parent epic `chatticus-598be4`. Blocked by `chatticus-be3997` (user-facing turn grant HTTP).

## What to ship

Workspace UI for an enabled member to submit a **full closed grant** (replace, not merge) for the active turn. Distinct from consequential send/purchase approval.

## Constraints

- Gherkin first. Depends on the user HTTP route existing.
- Do not invent a second grant model.
- `run_terminal` is offered only as an explicit grant tool, never as a default checkbox that silently lands in the conversation preset.

## Gherkin

```gherkin
Feature: Workspace UI to replace an active turn grant
  As an enabled organization member
  I want to replace the active turn grant from the product workspace
  So I do not need the members CLI or a kernel to authorize a task

  Scenario: A member submits a closed grant from the workspace
    Given the member is signed in to the product workspace
    And a turn is active under the household conversation grant
    When the member submits a closed grant that includes browse to an origin
    Then the active turn grant is exactly that closed grant
```

## Done when

A member can replace the active turn grant from the product workspace without the members CLI or kernel.

comments.text: Plan authorized with three amendments: merge `origin/develop` first (README #332); split `run_terminal` into two Gherkin scenarios (checked vs unchecked); `behave` from `python/` uses `../features/web_turn_grant.feature`. Do not offer send/purchase in the form. Google SPA still blocks live UI automation — harness is the gate; browser check if a session exists, otherwise record the same named blocker as create-bot.
